title: The Pre-Snap Scan
learnerWin: Before the snap, make a one-sentence plan from shell, box, leverage, and a safe answer.
lab: Set the same offensive formation against a two-high shell and a one-high shell in Practice Mode.
Before each snap say: shell, box, leverage, plan.
Do not grade yourself by whether the play works. Grade the scan and decision.
sources: EA Sports, Madden NFL 27 Gameplay Deep Dive — controls and adjustment context.
Huddle.gg, Madden 27 Playbooks — formation/playbook mapping reference.
